summary: [MOCK] 4 error classes detected across checkout-service and orders-db; events correlated into one incident window.

findings.title: Database connection pool exhausted
findings.description: checkout-service reported 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available' 214 times between 10:01 and 10:04 UTC.

findings.title: Database connection timeouts
findings.description: Classified 188 events as DB_TIMEOUT (30000ms connection acquisition timeout).

findings.title: Increased API response time
findings.description: POST /api/checkout p95 latency rose from 320ms to 29800ms.

findings.title: Checkout request failures
findings.description: HTTP 503 responses on POST /api/checkout increased to 41% of requests.

evidence.content: 2026-10-31T10:01:12Z ERROR HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms (total=50, active=50, idle=0, waiting=187)
evidence.relevance: Shows pool at max size with all connections active.
Checkout failure coinciding with pool exhaustion.
